description: This Java class 'Macros' provides methods to generate and manage code macros related to Android navigation templates, including loading template methods, creating macro instances, and managing macro configurations for projects.

classes.name: Macros
classes.description: A class that manages code macros for Android navigation templates, including loading template methods and creating macro instances.

methods.name: getMethodsByName
methods.description: Loads a Java template file, extracts the method body, creates a PsiClass from it, and retrieves methods by name.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton Macros instance for a given project, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: createMacro
methods.description: Creates a MultiMatch macro object from a method definition string.
